note: criterionId is required — there is no criterion to withdraw from without it.
Unknown top-level member is rejected — withdrawal takes no parameters to retire selectively; rotate labels with vtc/vetting/hidden/publish instead.
withdrawn and requirementsDigest are both required on a response — a caller must be told whether anything changed.
withdrawn is a boolean, not a count or a string.
The response carries no parameters — withdrawal publishes nothing, so a stored or published member has no place in it.
